about.whoText: A Florida company formation and registered agent service for first-time founders, Hispanic and immigrant entrepreneurs, contractors, out-of-state owners and investors.
about.whatText: We prepare and file your Articles of Organization or Incorporation, obtain your EIN, serve as your registered agent and remind you before every annual report.
about.approachText: Plain language, clear timelines and one point of contact. We explain each step in English or Spanish so nothing is a surprise.
